name: n4_schedule_audit
description: Audit every schedule below base in one read-only call (station-audits S12): the boolean, numeric, enum and string schedules and the calendars (BQL select slotPath, knobCount from schedule:ControlSchedule; trigger schedules are not listed). schedules has one entry per schedule: {schedule (ORD), type, kind, out_value, next_time, next_value, special_events: {count, upcoming}, linked_targets, notes} (out_status too when out's status is not ok). out_value and next_value are plain values as n4_read_schedule gives them; next_time is the station's BAbsTime text, null when the station holds the null time (no next event). special_events.count is how many special events the schedule holds (a calendar: how many dates); upcoming lists those whose first day falls in the horizon from the station's date (SystemService systemTime), as {name, kind, date (YYYY-MM-DD), rule, ranges (start, end, value by time)} plus calendar for a reference event; it is null when the station's date could not be read. A reference event names a calendar: calendars lists each one {ord, resolves, why?} (resolves false when it does not load as a schedule:CalendarSchedule). A rule this audit does not evaluate (calendarWeek1..6, before_last7/14/21, a date range with other wildcards) is never guessed: it is left out of upcoming with a note. linked_targets is the schedule's knob count (BComponent.getKnobCount: the links that read it, from any slot; in practice out); unlinked lists the non-calendar schedules with none ({schedule}); calendars, referenced rather than linked, carry referenced_by (reference events in the audited schedules naming them) instead. If the station refuses knobCount, linked_targets and unlinked are null with a note. no_next_event lists the schedules whose next_time is the null time. A value that cannot be read is null with a note in that entry, never guessed; a schedule that cannot be loaded is listed under unreadable {schedule, error}. counts holds the totals (schedules, calendars, unlinked, no_next_event, upcoming_events, unreadable); truncated is true when the list stopped at max_schedules. One BQL read, one SystemService load, then one load per schedule and per referenced calendar outside the list. Read-only.

base.description: Slot ORD of the folder to audit, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Schedules (default: the whole station)

horizon.description: How far ahead to list special events and holidays, in days from the station's date, e.g. 7d (1d to 366d)
